command_filter_reference.wn_role: command_filter parameter only; not a measured or inferred closed-loop attitude-inner-loop bandwidth
command_filter_reference.lp_cutoff_derivation: 18/(2*pi), used only as a nominal command-filter scale anchor; the replay LP is not transfer-function equivalent to the second-order command filter

mlp_alpha1_hf6.interpretation: The command filter changes both amplitude and phase. These same-state reference/task comparisons are conditional trace metrics, not achievable-error lower/upper bounds or closed-loop counterfactuals. The unfiltered-target metric does not support increasing command-filter bandwidth as a likely task improvement. The fixed LP gives only modest conditional improvement and is not prioritized for closed-loop evaluation.

force_scale_screen.interpretation: Uniformly scaling the applied position NN force by 0.9 slightly improves HF task error but worsens Q in both attitude-module cohorts; it is not a joint task/position fix.

compensation_spectrum.interpretation: Most compensation magnitude lies below 10 Hz; attenuating only high-frequency ripple does not explain the observed position/task tradeoff.

matched_b_c5_cross_loop_phase.signals: yaw-rotated horizontal position error versus task-attitude error, followed by acceleration error versus task-attitude error

offline_wind_corrected_acceleration_erro.note: Logged wind was used only for offline explanatory subtraction. It is not a proposed runtime input.

matched_b_c5_cross_loop_phase.interpretation: The observed B/C5 phase association is confounded by disturbance and outer-loop response and does not identify a causal controller defect or prove a physical limit.

tracking_parameters.error_reference: filtered Euler reference minus actual ZYX Euler
tracking_parameters.surface_map: actual ZYX T maps body omega to Euler rate; T-transpose maps the clipped tracking surface to body coordinates

gru_tracking_trace.interpretation: No sign, coordinate, reference, event-dt, position-scale binding, or attitude-residual clipping mismatch was found. The audit revision decodes MATLAB uint16 text for alpha; the earlier draft's value 48 was the codepoint for character '0'. No runtime, release, or raw data changed.

next_testable_structure_hypothesis.preserve: C5 nominal BS force path and full position force compensation (alpha=1); frozen metrics
next_testable_structure_hypothesis.change: A causal position DSSM interface that augments the existing 14 inputs with command-filter rate and PCF realization eta (about 20 input features), retains 3D force-residual output, and predicts the next 10-ms residual
next_testable_structure_hypothesis.reason: These deployable states encode filter/realization phase missing from the current inference feature vector; the existing 20D branch makes this a small interface change.
next_testable_structure_hypothesis.status: hypothesis_only; compare against historical C5 HF repair interface before freezing the next candidate

c5_context: A prior C5 HF position regression was mostly repaired by later changes. This report does not claim position-task coupling is physically unfixable; the cross-loop phase metrics are diagnostic associations only.
